verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS agent platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such reference or runnable examples. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path and no llms.txt. The Agent SDK material covers writing journeys as code and inspecting API calls in traces, which is a different feature from an explorable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
